paragraphs: Rav Idi instituted a practice in Naresh, Niddah 67b. Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi said [a teaching]; Rav Idi said [of it], “These are only words of prophecy,” Eruvin 60b. Tosafot write that he said this in praise; see their lengthy discussion. Rav Adda bar Acha and Rabbi Hamnuna in Rav’s name, Jerusalem Talmud, Berakhot, chapter 1, mishnah 5. Before Rabbi Yose, in Rabbi Chisda’s name, there, Yevamot, chapter 11. Rabbi Mesharshya in his name; Rav Natan bar Yosef in his name.
